content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Toledo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma/associate degree plus five years of experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your education and project hours before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions from anywhere in Ohio on a schedule that fits your work at ProMedica, Stellantis, or elsewhere. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world examples and interactive instruction over multiple weeks.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI with proof of education and project experience. Pay the PMI examination fee at that time. PMI will review and approve your application before you can schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides aligned to the PMBOK Guide. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions and clarify complex topics.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle by attending training, conferences, or completing project-management work. Submit your renewal application and PDU documentation to PMI before your credential expires.
